title: Quản lý đa dạng sinh học

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts related to biodiversity management.
Recognize the importance and value of biodiversity, current status, and threats to biodiversity globally and in Vietnam.
Understand principles of conservation and management of biodiversity at genetic, species, and ecosystem levels.
Understand legal instruments used for managing and sustainably exploiting natural resources.
Understand economic tools used for managing and sustainably exploiting natural resources.
Understand technical tools used for managing and sustainably exploiting natural resources.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Educational and Traditional Tools for Biodiversity Management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand educational and traditional tools used for managing and sustainably exploiting natural resources.
Develop research skills to solve practical problems related to biodiversity management at national and local levels.
Develop discussion and explanation skills for research and biodiversity management in practice.
